text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"more varied sentence patterns and paragraphing","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the essay is organized into linked paragraphs that develop separate points and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"I have a friend...\" \"I'm a girl...\" \"I have a teacher...\"","quality":"supporting examples","description":"This captures the use of specific personal examples to develop ideas rather than only naming them."},{"evidence":"\"helps me to forget all the problems\" \"they were kind with me\" \"you can be a teacher of art or sculpture\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures how each point is expanded with details and explanations instead of staying at a bare statement."},{"evidence":"\"the guitar class is very amusing and interesting\" \"they were kind with me\"","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures more precise and expressive vocabulary for describing experiences and effects."},{"evidence":"\"Most of students live with so much stress\" \"The performance class helps students\"","quality":"control of grammar","description":"This captures somewhat stronger control of English sentence structure, even though errors are still frequent."}]}
